caption: The drawing features a single ceramic pitcher that occupies the center of the image, set against a plain, light-colored background. The pitcher is primarily painted in light beige or off-white colors with a glossy texture, and it has a rounded body, a single handle, and a spout at the top. It is decorated with a pattern of large, colorful flowers and green leaves that are distributed across its surface. The flowers are in shades of red, blue, and yellow, with green stems and leaves connecting them. A dark blue stripe decorates the rim of the pitcher, encircling it near the top. Subtle reflections and shading suggest the curvature and shine of the ceramic surface. The artist’s signature, "A. Walbeck," is visible in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Pitcher
